test.create_query: CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_probe (k String, v1 String, v2 String, v3 String, v4 Nullable(String), v5 Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_mid (k String, m UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_build (k String, t DateTime) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_wide (k UInt64, s String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE lazy_sort_fan (k UInt64, t UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO lazy_sort_probe SELECT toString(number), concat('u', toString(number), '@example.com'), concat('t', toString(number % 7)), concat('k', toString(number % 50)), if(number % 10 = 0, NULL, concat('m', toString(number % 500))), (number % 1000) / 10. FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_mid SELECT toString(number), number % 5 FROM numbers(1000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_build SELECT toString(number % 1000000), toDateTime('2024-02-01 00:00:00') + number FROM numbers(3000000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_wide SELECT number, repeat(toString(number), intDiv(10000, length(toString(number)))) FROM numbers(2000)
INSERT INTO lazy_sort_fan SELECT number % 2000, cityHash64(number) FROM numbers(200000)
test.query: SELECT p.k, p.v1, p.v2, p.v3, p.v4, p.v5, b.t FROM lazy_sort_probe p INNER JOIN lazy_sort_build b ON b.k = p.k ORDER BY b.t FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_join_swap_table = false, enable_lazy_columns_replication = {lazy}

SELECT p.k, p.v1, p.v2, p.v3, p.v4, p.v5, b.t FROM lazy_sort_probe p INNER JOIN lazy_sort_build b ON b.k = p.k ORDER BY p.k FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_join_swap_table = false, enable_lazy_columns_replication = {lazy}

SELECT p.k, p.v1, p.v2, p.v3, p.v4, p.v5, m.m, b.t FROM lazy_sort_probe p INNER JOIN lazy_sort_mid m ON m.k = p.k INNER JOIN lazy_sort_build b ON b.k = p.k ORDER BY b.t FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_join_swap_table = false, enable_lazy_columns_replication = 0, query_plan_min_columns_for_join_lazy_indexing = {lazy_indexing}
SELECT p.s, b.t FROM lazy_sort_wide p INNER JOIN lazy_sort_fan b ON b.k = p.k ORDER BY b.t FORMAT Null SETTINGS query_plan_join_swap_table = false
